comments.author: @UnrealWorldJourney1
comments.text: The most fascinating part of these homes is imagining the everyday logistics behind them. 🏔 Building on a cliff or remote mountain is impressive enough, but then come water, food, repairs, transportation and surviving extreme weather year after year. These houses are really monuments to human adaptation as much as they are examples of unusual architecture.

replies.author: @EXPLOREHORIZONS66
replies.text: That’s a brilliant perspective; the ingenuity required for daily survival in those locations is truly humbling!
